rules.label: Subheading rule
rules.text: Notwithstanding subdivision (e)(ii) of this note, subdivision (e)(i) applies to nonoriginating truffles of subheading 0709.59 used in the production of mixtures of mushrooms and truffles of subheading 0709.59 and nonoriginating capers of subheading 0711.90 used in the production of mixtures of vegetables of subheading 0711.90.
A change to headings 0701 through 0711 from any other chapter.
A change to subheadings 0712.20 through 0712.39 from any other chapter.

(A) A change to savory, crushed or ground, of subheading 0712.90 from savory, neither crushed nor ground, of subheading 0712.90 or any other chapter; or
(B) A change to any other good of subheading 0712.90 from any other chapter.
A change to headings 0713 through 0714 from any other chapter.
